topic: Kiri: Rust container runtime vs Docker Desktop

youtube.title: Docker in 2.55 ms? This Rust Runtime Wants to Replace Docker Desktop 🦀

scenes.say: Docker run... in eighteen milliseconds? A new Rust container runtime is taking on Docker Desktop.

scenes.title: Kiri
scenes.say: Meet Kiri. It's written in Rust, open source under Apache 2.0, and runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

scenes.heading: Keep your workflow
scenes.sub: It speaks the Docker Engine API
scenes.say: And you keep your workflow. Kiri speaks the Docker Engine API, so the Docker CLI and Docker Compose just work.

scenes.heading: Container start time
scenes.say: How fast? In the author's own benchmark, Kiri started an Alpine container in 2.55 milliseconds, versus 213 for Docker Desktop. That hasn't been independently verified yet.

scenes.heading: How it runs
scenes.say: On macOS and Windows, containers run inside a Linux VM. On Linux, they run directly on the kernel.

scenes.heading: Brand new
scenes.sub: Worth watching. Maybe not prod yet.
scenes.say: It's brand new. The repo opened November second, and version 0.2 shipped November tenth. Early days, but worth watching.

scenes.heading: Try it
question: Would you switch from Docker Desktop?
scenes.say: Find it at github dot com slash libracoder slash kiri. Would you switch from Docker Desktop? Tell me in the comments.
